# Vector operations

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("discussions", "w3discussion", "data", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("discussions", "w3discussion", "data", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("discussions", "w3discussion", "data", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here("discussions", "w3discussion", "data", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```


```{r}
# Select bird observations within protected areas in Santa Barbara County 

aves_PA_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ] # Subset. Default intersects. Output is sb_protected areas (polygons), not aves points
aves_PA_join <- st_join(x = sb_protected_areas, y = aves, join = st_intersects, left = FALSE) # Join. Output is bird observation points

# Check number of rows

nrow(aves_PA_subset) # 35 protected polygons have birds in them
nrow(aves_PA_join) # 103 birds are in protected polygons
```


```{r}
# Plot subset
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_PA_subset) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")

# Plot join
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_PA_join) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```


```{r}
# 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

st_crs(sb_protected_areas)$units # Check if units are in meters

PA_buffer_5km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = 5000) # Create 5000 m buffer around PAs

aves_buffer_subset <- PA_buffer_5km[aves, ] # Subset

nrow(aves_buffer_subset) # 327 rows
```


```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_buffer_subset) +
  tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```


```{r}
# Protected areas within 15 km of a city in Santa Barbara County

# Subset SB county to Goleta
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
  dplyr::filter(NAME == "Goleta")

st_crs(goleta)$units  # Check if units are in meters

goleta_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = 15000) # Create 15 km buffer around Goleta
```


```{r}
# 3 different ways to find protected areas within 15 km of goleta

goleta_PAs_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # True if protected areas lies entirely inside the buffer. predicate to sparse list

goleta_PAs_intersect <- st_intersects(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # True if protected area touches or overlaps the buffer at all. predicate to sparse list

goleta_PAs_intersection <- st_intersection(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km) # Clips each overlapping polygon to buffer boundary. geometry to new sf object
```

```{r}
sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_within) > 0) # 177

sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_intersect) > 0) # 185

nrow(goleta_PAs_intersection) # 185
```

```{r}
# Distance based join

goleta_PAs_join <- st_join(sb_protected_areas, goleta, st_is_within_distance, dist = 15000)
```


```{r}
# Distance between goleta and dangermond edge to edge

dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")

danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond)
danger_dist
```


```{r}
# Calculate the geometric center 

dangermond_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
goleta_centroid <- st_centroid(goleta)

danger_dist_centroid <- st_distance(goleta_centroid, dangermond_centroid) # Compute the distance between geometries centers
danger_dist_centroid
```


```{r}
# Check if the distance matrices are equal
danger_dist == danger_dist_centroid
```
